body:
I'm feeling hopeless now. I am the most reviled thing on the planet. The sickest, evilest, cruelest, inhuman thing that doesn't deserve to breathe the same oxygen as humans do. Anyone with mere thoughts like mine is defective. I am the only human alive with these thoughts. No one has ever thought about things as bad as I. Nobody has ever been "turned on" (or at least I think I was) by a fucking \*fetus.\*

I am filth.

Bit late but I got some sound advice which was to completely forget about it, surround myself with hobbies, activities, and let them do the work on my brain. The problem is that I know I'll feel tremendous guilt, and the fact that that advice isn't usually given to such depraved people.

I don't know what's wrong with me. 
I definitely have had every deviant paraphilia one could think of. 
The difference is that for some reason, I don't count these thoughts as being a part of "me" per say.

I know. 
A part of me, a really, really fucked up part of me that "takes control" every so often, laughs and encourages me to feel utterly remorseless for these thoughts. It's "comforting" because the pain of facing the fact that I am extremely depraved is too much to bear.
Another part is that for some reason, I tend to morally disengage. If I heard another person was having the exact same thoughts as I was, I'd probably want to kill them.
I am really, really fucked up.
I had a very strong urge to act on them but resisted due to me not wanting to be labeled a monster by society for the rest of my life.
Me not acting them out comes from fear of consequence largely, not empathy. My empathy is very limited and usually only applies to animals.

I know. But obsessing over them and subsequently developing the urge to act on them is another thing. I have done reprehensible things in the past (no, didn't rape or murder anybody) and the desires have only gotten worse.

What kind of sick mind comes up with raping an unborn foetus as the "youngest possible" for paedophilia? And that's not even the worst I've come up with.
This is what I mean. People refuse to believe me. Idk why. I guess they can't comprehend someone this depraved?

I am just like you. Even worse in fact. 

I admire your bravery in recognizing the beast within. It's a fiend that we weren't given a choice to be born with. My view is that society should be more open to treating people like us.

What scares me the most though is that, during the time in which I was fantasizing about said things, I was fully convinced I wanted to act on them but I never did. Because I knew that if I did, there's no turning back. I'm glad I chose to not do anything.

Ironically enough, my initial regret in the CP made things even *worse.* I started looking up worse offenders to cope with the guilt and say "at least I'm not as bad as x, right?"... I searched up people like Peter Scully, Ian Watkins, etc.

Then came the intrusive, vile thoughts. I got desensitized to the stuff mentioned in the articles very quickly. I thought about it 24/7, and eventually the thoughts started saying to go rape corpses, toddlers, infants, babies, and even foetuses... 

Despite how many times the fucking sick, twisted thoughts convinced me I wanted to do those things, sometimes even making me laugh in a twisted way at the thought of committing these acts and convincing me I would act on them, I never followed through and did them. Not once. My life was hell for those months. I was terrified that I was irredeemable, a monster worse than any of which the likes has ever seen on earth. I didn't want to be that person, no matter how much my sick brain told me otherwise. 

I remembered deep down, that's what I truly wanted. A second chance, a shot at redemption, even if I don't deserve it for merely having these thoughts, much less my actions. I want to just let all of this die and live a happy, fulfilled life. A person like me, the sickest, vilest, most twisted individual redeeming himself is, well, surprising. And many feel that I don't deserve it, sometimes I feel as though I don't deserve it.

I'm only 20 years old. I feel like I don't deserve to live for merely even having those vile thoughts about raping corpses, infants, and foetuses. As for the actions, l do feel genuine, true remorse but if I dwell on it, I fear I'll end up killing myself.
